candidates.name: Dalton Lateral Expansion II Project
candidates.sponsor: Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Company, LLC
candidates.from: Dalton Lateral transfer point near Compressor Station 115, Coweta County GA

evidence.note: EIA Aug 2026 release, sheet 'Natural Gas Pipeline Projects' row 36: 115 mi path, +460 MMcf/d, in service 2029, pipeline looping plus compression

candidates.why_maybe_new: No Dalton Lateral row on roster (earlier 2017 Dalton Expansion not found either). 115 mi is the lateral path; the new looping length is unknown, so length unknown beyond the EIA figure. Likely at least 25 km of loop but unverified.

candidates.name: CGT West Virginia
aka: Columbia Gas Transmission West Virginia expansion

evidence.note: EIA Aug 2026 historical sheet row 11: 17.5 mi (28.2 km) of 20 in pipe, +28.2 MMcf/d, FERC docket CP95-217-000, in service 1996

candidates.why_maybe_new: EIA only; no GEM row matches. 17.5 mi is just above the 25 km floor; single source, route not identified. Could be a Columbia system loop never captured separately.
